expected: Route found across the whole network

expected: Route found; not faster than the optimal A* route (ST05)

scenario: Greedy Best-First Search on a long trip
expected: Route found; not faster than the optimal A* route (ST05)

scenario: Date outside the data (2 November 2006)
expected: Error: time must be within the data range
actual: Error: Time must be between 2006-10-01 03:00 and 2006-10-31 23:45 (the models need the 3 hours of data before the departure time).

scenario: Reverse direction of ST01 (3002 -> 2000)
expected: Route found; uses the same roads in reverse order

scenario: Weekend morning (Saturday 28 Oct 08:00)
expected: Route found; trip not slower than the weekday peak (ST01)

scenario: Time not on a 15-minute step (08:07)
expected: Rounded down to 08:00; same result as ST01

scenario: Only one route asked for
expected: Exactly 1 route, the same as ST01 route 1
